videos.caption: We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

¡Tensión Extrema! Abuela Cae en la Guarida del Tigre y Su Hija Salta para Salvarla en un Zoológico de Pesadilla ​ ​¡Quedó a centímetros de las garras! Lo que debía ser un día de paseo familiar se convirtió en una pesadilla de alto riesgo. Una mujer de la tercera edad experimentó el pánico absoluto al desplomarse la baranda de seguridad, cayendo en picada directamente al recinto de un imponente tigre adulto. El estruendo de la caída y los gritos de horror de los visitantes inundaron el lugar. En un acto de valentía desesperada, su hija no lo dudó: saltó al foso para interponerse entre su madre y el depredador. El enorme felino, una mole de músculo y dientes, las observaba a escasos metros. Contra todo pronóstico, y en un desenlace milagroso, ambas salieron ¡totalmente ilesas! La rápida y audaz intervención de los cuidadores, que lograron distraer al animal y activar de inmediato el protocolo de emergencia, evitó una tragedia. El impactante suceso dejó a todos los presentes en estado de shock y desató una tormenta de críticas sobre las alarmantes fallas de seguridad y el mantenimiento del zoológico.

While not as powerful as an adult’s roar, these sounds are an adorable glimpse into the cub’s journey of learning and growing into a formidable predator.
